items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I’ve seen Stevie Wonder do it, you know, in similar situations.

ctx.x: Oh, good, good. And so I’m, here we are here about three in the morning, so forth, and he’s playing excerpts and singing excerpts from his third sacred concert saying, “How do you like this? How do you like that?” And I’m saying, I’m in this group and he’s asking, and I’m saying, I can’t believe, like you said, “I can’t believe I’m here.” And he’s sounding like he’s forty years old because he’s into that music so much and playing and just saying, you know. I’ve seen Stevie Wonder do it, you know, in similar…
